# PatternProof

> Private documentation app for survivors of domestic abuse and high-conflict custody cases. Helps log incidents, organize evidence, and generate source-linked evidence exports for professional review.

PatternProof is a private, encrypted journal and case-building tool. All data is per-user and protected by row-level security. Most pages live behind authentication.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Entry point that routes to dashboard or sign in.
- [Sign in / Create account](/login): Account access for survivors.

## Optional

- [Attorney access](/attorney): Read-only shared bundles open only with a private token link issued by a user.
